BANKA FESTIVAL

Banka.Festival is an electroclash music event set in Lido di Venezia. For this branding exercise, I developed the visual identity and a series of posters, exploring a bold and energetic visual language. The project focuses on creating a strong and recognizable system that reflects the atmosphere and rhythm of the festival.
